blocks.raw: # Edit or Disable a Cart Promotion
blocks.text: Edit or Disable a Cart Promotion

blocks.raw: You can manage the lifecycle of your promotions through the centralized list view. This allows you to update campaign durations, adjust creative messaging, remove underperforming offers, or reactivate a previously deactivated promotion.
blocks.text: You can manage the lifecycle of your promotions through the centralized list view. This allows you to update campaign durations, adjust creative messaging, remove underperforming offers, or reactivate a previously deactivated promotion.

blocks.raw: ## Deactivate a cart promotion
blocks.text: Deactivate a cart promotion

blocks.raw: If a promotion is no longer required or was created in error:
blocks.text: If a promotion is no longer required or was created in error:

blocks.raw:
1. Go to **Engage+ > Campaigns**.
2. Select the specific **Campaign** containing your promotion.
3. Navigate to the **Promotions** tab to view the list of all created cart promotions.
4. Locate the promotion in the list.
5. Click the **Three-Dot Menu (⋮)**.
6. Select **Deactivate**.
blocks.text: Go to Engage+ > Campaigns.Select the specific Campaign containing your promotion.Navigate to the Promotions tab to view the list of all created cart promotions.Locate the promotion in the list.Click the Three-Dot Menu (⋮).Select Deactivate.

blocks.raw: ## Activate a cart promotion
blocks.text: Activate a cart promotion

blocks.raw: You can reactivate a deactivated promotion from the same promotions list. The **Activate** option appears in the three-dot menu only when a promotion is in an inactive state.
blocks.text: You can reactivate a deactivated promotion from the same promotions list. The Activate option appears in the three-dot menu only when a promotion is in an inactive state.

blocks.raw:
1. Go to **Engage+ > Campaigns**.
2. Select the specific **Campaign** containing your promotion.
3. Navigate to the **Promotions** tab to view the list of all created cart promotions.
4. Locate the deactivated promotion in the list.
5. Click the **Three-Dot Menu (⋮)** at the end of the promotion row.
6. Select **Activate**.

   <Image src="https://files.readme.io/a2696053d3fb7ad5789072c45060afd495ff148e0ba1855caf15bb04d64ff579-image.png" border={true} />

blocks.raw: 7) A confirmation prompt appears. Select **Yes** to activate the promotion.
blocks.text: A confirmation prompt appears. Select Yes to activate the promotion.

blocks.raw: A success notification confirms that the promotion has been activated. The promotion list refreshes automatically to reflect the updated status.
